import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

NS = {'m': 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'}

z = zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx')
print("--- Files in archive ---")
for n in z.namelist():
    print(n)

# Load shared strings
shared = []
if 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in z.namelist():
    root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
    for si in root.findall('m:si', NS):
        text = ''.join(t.text or '' for t in si.iter('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}t'))
        shared.append(text)

print("--- Shared strings ---")
for i, s in enumerate(shared):
    print(i, repr(s))

# Load first sheet
sheet_name = None
root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
for sh in root.find('m:workbook', NS).findall('m:sheets/m:sheet', NS):
    print("Sheet:", sh.get('name'), sh.get('sheetId'))

wb_rel = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels'))
rels = {}
for rel in wb_rel.findall('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships}Relationship'):
    rels[rel.get('Id')] = rel.get('Target')

# find first worksheet
sheet_xml_path = None
wb_root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
sheets_el = wb_root.find('m:workbook', NS).find('m:sheets', NS)
first_sheet = sheets_el.find('m:sheet', NS)
rid = first_sheet.get('{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships}id')
target = rels[rid]
if not target.startswith('xl/'):
    target = 'xl/' + target
sheet_xml_path = target
print("First sheet xml:", sheet_xml_path, "name:", first_sheet.get('name'))

import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

M = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'
R = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships'
P = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/package/2006/relationships'
NS = {'m': M, 'r': R, 'p': P}

z = zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx')

# Shared strings
shared = []
if 'xl/sharedStrings.xml' in z.namelist():
    root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/sharedStrings.xml'))
    for si in root.findall('m:si', NS):
        text = ''.join(t.text or '' for t in si.iter(M + 't'))
        shared.append(text)
print("--- Shared strings ---")
for i, s in enumerate(shared):
    print(i, repr(s))

# Workbook sheets
wb_root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/workbook.xml'))
print("--- Sheets ---")
for sh in wb_root.find('m:sheets', NS).findall('m:sheet', NS):
    print(sh.get('name'), sh.get('sheetId'))

# Relationships
wb_rel = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/_rels/workbook.xml.rels'))
rels = {}
for rel in wb_rel.findall('p:Relationship', NS):
    rels[rel.get('Id')] = rel.get('Target')

        if t == 's' and val != '':

        cells.append(f"{ref}={val!r}(t={t})")

import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from collections import OrderedDict

M = 'http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main'
NS = {'m': M}

z = zipfile.ZipFile('budget.xlsx')
root = ET.fromstring(z.read('xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml'))

def cell_text(c):
    t = c.get('t')
    if t == 'inlineStr':
        is_el = c.find('m:is', NS)
        return ''.join(tt.text or '' for tt in is_el.iter(M + 't')) if is_el is not None else ''
    v = c.find('m:v', NS)
    return v.text if v is not None else None

rows = {}
for row in root.find('m:sheetData', NS).findall('m:row', NS):
    r = int(row.get('r'))
    rows[r] = {c.get('r')[0]: cell_text(c) for c in row.findall('m:c', NS)}

print("=== INCOME (col B) ===")
income_total = 0
for r in range(4, 8):
    label = rows.get(r, {}).get('A')
    val = rows.get(r, {}).get('B')
    print(f"  {label}: {val}")
    income_total += int(val)
print(f"  Total Income (B8 formula SUM(B4:B7)): {income_total}")

print("\n=== EXPENSES (col C) ===")
cat_totals = OrderedDict()
grand = 0
for r in range(11, 23):
    cat = rows.get(r, {}).get('A')
    item = rows.get(r, {}).get('B')
    val = int(rows.get(r, {}).get('C'))
    grand += val
    cat_totals[cat] = cat_totals.get(cat, 0) + val
    print(f"  {cat:15s} | {item:15s} | {val}")

print("\n=== By category ===")
for cat, tot in cat_totals.items():
    print(f"  {cat:15s}: {tot}")
print(f"\nTOTAL EXPENSES (sum of C11:C22, matches C23 formula =SUM(C11:C22)): {grand}")
